name: Colugo The Complete Stroller

notes: The Complete is a reversible-seat, 175-degree lie-flat travel/everyday stroller (24.5 lb with seat / ~15 lb frame). It appears DISCONTINUED: Colugo's own site now sells only the Compact+, and the Amazon listing is 'Currently unavailable'; best live third-party price is Rebel $301.99 (reg $465) but Out of Stock. Clek Liing attaches via Colugo's Universal Car Seat Adapter, which Clek's list marks *Discontinued (adapter-colugo-universal). Folded dims and brake type are not officially published by Colugo — folded figures come from a hands-on review, so treat as approximate.
